Rufe karfen abinci da sinadaran karfafa ma'adanai

coltan.complianceNote: Kowace kaya tana fuskantar gwajin radiation na tilas da tabbatarwa daga dakin bincike mai zaman kansa don biyan bukatun kamfanonin jiragen ruwa da masu saya na kasa da kasa.

Buhunan Jumbo na 1,000 kg FIBC akan Pallet
Akwatunan Kwantenoli na Fitarwa Masu Rufe na Tsaro

Gaurayen nickel-niobium superalloys don injunan jirgin sama
Kera karfen gini mai karfin gaske

engineering.headingPart1: Kammalawa da Ginin Ababen Injinjiya Masu Nauyi da
engineering.intro: Saman hakar danyen ma'adanai, sashenmu na injinjiya a Abuja yana gudanar da manyan ayyukan hakar kasa, gini mai karfi da konkrete, rukunin motocin safara daga ma'adana, da binciken kasa na geological a karkashin babban shugabanci daya.
engineering.bannerBadge: GUDANAR DA AYYUKAN FILI DAGA FARA ZUWA KARSHE
engineering.bannerTitle: Rikewar Aiki Hannu Daya Daga Hakar Kasa Zuwa Mawa Kamfani Aikin.
engineering.bannerBody: Ta hanyar hada kayan fasa duwatsunmu, na'urorin tono kasa, da injiniyoyin gini masu lasisi, ma'aikatun gwamnati da masu gine-ginen kasuwanci suna kawar da jinkirin 'yan kwangila da yawa da matsalolin ingancin kaya.

Saita hanyoyin tifa da hanyoyin kwararar ruwan sama
Tantance ma'adana, wuraren fasa dutse da sarrafa kaya
Sake gyara kasan ma me aka haka da gina katangar tsaro
capabilities.equipmentOrMethodology: Hydraulic Excavators na Tani 30T–45T · Bulldozers · Manyan Motocin Dump Trucks

capabilities.title: Ginin Ababen Hada-hada da Injinjiya
capabilities.subtitle: Ginin Ababen Infrastructure, Masana'antu da Muhallai
capabilities.description: Ayyukan injinjiyan gini tun daga farko zuwa karshe a fadin Najeriya—isar da gine-gine masu karfi, hanyoyin kwararar ruwa, rumbun adana kaya na masana'antu, da ginin unguwanni.
deliverables: Gada mai concrete, magudanan ruwa da bango mai karfi
Rumbun masana'antu, tushen mizani da runfunan sarrafa kaya
Hanyoyin mota na kasuwanci da gidaje da magudanar ruwa
Yin amfani da duwatsu, concrete da kwalta da aka gwada ingancinsu
capabilities.equipmentOrMethodology: Tsarin Gini na BS / NIS · Gwajin Ingancin Kayan Gini QA/QC · Kulawar Aiki tun daga Farko

deliverables: Excavators na roba/karfe, bulldozers da wheel loaders na kwangila
Articulated dump trucks da motocin tifa na Tani 30T–45T
Na'urorin fasa dutse da matatar zakulawa
Hanyar safara daga ma'adana zuwa tashar ruwa ta kwantenoli ko motoci

deliverables: Taswirar geological, hakar ramuka da daukar samfurin dutse
Kulawa da hakar rami da adana samfuran duwatsu
Kimanta adadin ma'adana da tsarin sarrafa inganci
Binciken Tasiri akan Muhalli (EIA) da rahoton biye da doka

projects.headingPart1: Safara daga Ma'adana zuwa Wurin Gini da
projects.intro: Shirya hakar ma'adanai, sarrafa awo a mizani, tabbatar da gwajin dakin gwaji, da safara kai tsaye a cikin manyan yankunan ma'adanai na Najeriya da garuruwan gine-gine.

corridors.title: Hanyar Safarar Pegmatite da Danyen Karfe na Tsakiyar Arewa
corridors.summary: Tsara samun kaya, saita girma, da sanya buhunan jumbo don lithium (spodumene/lepidolite), kwalba/cassiterite tin, coltan, da danyen karfe na 60–65% Fe zuwa masana'antun cikin gida da tashoshin fitarwa na Lagos/Port Harcourt.

corridors.title: Rukunin Motocin Duwatsun Concrete da Tushen Titi na F.C.T. Abuja
corridors.summary: Rukunin motocin tifa na yau da kullum da ke isar da duwatsun granite na 1/2" da 3/4", garin dutse, wankakkiyar yallabar rariya, da kasa ja zuwa 'yan kwangilar babban titi, masana'antun concrete, da masu gine-ginen gidaje.

corridors.title: Tattara Galena da Sphalerite daga Benue Trough
corridors.corridor: Benue Trough → Tashoshin Ruwa na Onne / Apapa
corridors.summary: Tattara ingantaccen ma'adanin lead sulfide (PbS) da zinc sulfide (ZnS) tare da raba rukuni, kula da danshi, da duba amfani da XRF mai zaman kansa kafin cika kwantenoli.

corridors.title: Shirya Wurin Gini, Magudanan Ruwa da Ginshiƙan Masana'antu
corridors.corridor: F.C.T. Abuja da Wurare a Fadin Najeriya
corridors.summary: Hada tona kasa mai nauyi, danne tushen titi, ayyukan magudanan ruwa da concrete, da wadatar da kayan gini kai tsaye daga ma'adana a karkashin shugabanci daya amintacce.

stages.title: Tattara Kaddarori da Yarjejeniyar Aiki
stages.detail: Masu saya suna aiko da tani da ake bukata, ingancin sinadarai, wurin isarwa, da Incoterms ta hanyar Sashenmu na Sayayya ko takaitaccen bayanin injinjiya.

stages.title: Gwajin Lab Mai Zaman Kansa da Binciken Lasisi
stages.detail: Ana daukar samfuran rukuni don gwajin dakin gwaji mai shaidar amincewa, tabbatar da danshi, da takardun asalin ma'adana kafin kulla yarjejeniya.

stages.title: Sarrafawa, Daidaitawa da Sanya Buhu
stages.detail: Ana fasa ma'adanai, wanke su, ko sanya su a buhunan jumbo masu lamba na 1MT FIBC, buhunan PP na 50kg, kangunan tsaro, ko lodin motar tifa da aka auna.

stages.title: Safara daga Ma'adana zuwa Wurin Gini ko Tashar Fitarwa
stages.detail: Safara mai tsari tana isar da kaya kai tsaye zuwa wuraren gini a fadin Najeriya ko tashoshin fitarwa na Lagos (Apapa/Tin Can) da Port Harcourt.
